howToApply: Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position.
Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website: http://www.rites.com.

After filling up the required details, candidates must upload all documents under the ‘Upload Document’ section, including: High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth, Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications with mark sheets, Percentage Conversion Document (if applicable), EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate (if applicable), Proof of Identity & Address, PAN Card, Proof of experience, and any other supporting documents.
After uploading all documents, candidates are required to make online payment under the ‘Make Payment’ section.
Post successful payment of application fee, the final application form must be downloaded and a copy retained for future reference.
Applications without successful fee payment shall be treated as incomplete and shall be summarily rejected.
Hard copies of documents are NOT to be sent to the office through post/courier.
Candidates should submit only one application for one vacancy. Application once submitted cannot be altered.
